description: Returns verified bots in the bots.theta store: name, .theta name, pitch, category, price_tfuel, free_per_day, official, listing_ref. Use bots_discover to find bots, then bots_inspect for one bot's details, then bots_call to ask it. Read-only, free, no key. No match: count 0.

category.description: Only bots in this category (case-insensitive, as shown in each result's category)

q.description: Words to match in name, pitch, .theta name, category or tags, e.g. "tax" (max 100 chars)

name: bots_discover
title: Find bots
